# Wr001 — Trailing whitespace on every record line

<!-- Auto-generated; edit `STEP_PROBLEM_CATALOG.md` instead. -->

**Section**: §12.13 (`12-13-writer-pathology`)

**Sender**: Older FreeCAD STEP writer (pre-0.20) and some Pro/E export filters  

## Sources
- prostep ivip CAx-IF round-trip reports
- FreeCAD #4231 "STEP exporter pads lines with spaces"
- bug-reporter language: "diff between exports is all whitespace"

## Description

Every record line in the DATA section ends with one or more ASCII space (0x20) characters before the line terminator. Spec-conforming parsers accept this (whitespace is insignificant outside string literals), but downstream tools that diff exports for change-detection see noise on every line, version-control systems show every line as modified on every export, and crude line-based regex parsers that anchor on `;$` mis-match. Bug-reporter language: "STEP file has trailing spaces", "every line ends with whitespace", "diff is huge but nothing changed", "git keeps marking the file dirty".

## Reproducer recipe

minimal Part-21 file where each `#NNN=ENTITY(...);` line ends with `   ` (three spaces) before `\n`.

## Expected kernel behavior

read tolerantly — the spec permits insignificant whitespace anywhere outside string literals. Optionally normalise on re-emit. A downstream tool that warns on this is over-strict; a producer that emits this is sloppy but not malformed.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `heal`

## Notes

Practically harmless to parse; the cost is to humans who diff exports.
